opportunity.title: Short-Form Video Content Creation Package
opportunity.target_customer: Small businesses and content creators looking to enhance their social media presence on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
opportunity.customer_problem: Many small businesses and content creators struggle to produce engaging short-form video content that captures their brand and connects with their audience.
opportunity.proposed_solution: A comprehensive service that includes scriptwriting, video concept development, caption creation, and social media strategy tailored to their brand and goals.
deliverables: 3 original short-form video scripts (up to 60 seconds each)
Posting schedule and strategy guide for best times to post
Basic tips for on-camera presence and video shooting
opportunity.next_action: Create a detailed service outline and promotional materials to launch the offer.
